test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following sentence from active to passive:

The staff might have been installing the new server last night.

options.text: The staff installed the new server last night.
The server has been installed last night by the staff.
The new server might be installed last night by the staff.
The new server might have been installed last night by the staff.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The staff might have been installing the new server last night."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the new server" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "might have been installing" to "might have been installed" (passive form).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the staff."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "last night" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The new server might have been installed last night by the staff."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The staff installed the new server last night." – This is in active voice and does not match the required passive construction.
 
• **Option 2: **"The server has been installed last night by the staff." – Incorrect tense (past perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The new server might be installed last night by the staff." – Incorrect use of modal verb and tense.
